title: Pay the utilities network facilities tax
what: As the owner of a network facility (part of a utility network) on land in the ACT, pay the network facility tax, worked out on the route length at the determined rate.

sources.title: Utilities (Network Facilities Tax) Act 2006 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 8(1) (current republication (R3, from 23 June 2021; Utilities (Network Facilities Tax) Act 2006 | Acts))
sources.quote: The owner of a network facility on land in the ACT is liable to pay tax in relation to the facility at the rate worked out as follows: determined rate × route length

sources.title: Utilities (Network Facilities Tax) Act 2006 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 6(1) (current republication (R3, from 23 June 2021; Utilities (Network Facilities Tax) Act 2006 | Acts))
sources.quote: network facility means any part of the infrastructure of a utility network

administration.who: ACT Revenue Office (Commissioner for ACT Revenue)
